pages.text: One quiet evening, <name> wandered near the village pond. The moon shimmered on the water, and to his amazement, a unicorn with a silver mane and sparkling hooves stood at the edge, looking nervous.
The unicorn nodded shyly. A sparkling stream blocked its path, and it wasn’t sure how to cross. Stones glimmered in the water, but some were slippery, and a fallen log wobbled slightly.
<name> thought for a moment. “I’ll help you!” he said.

He held out his hand and guided the unicorn to the first stone. Step by step, the unicorn hopped carefully, <name> cheering softly. When they reached the fallen log, <name> steadied it with his little hands so the unicorn could cross safely.
At last, the unicorn reached the other side and shook its silver mane in delight. A soft glow spread from its horn, reflecting on the pond like tiny stars.
“Thank you, <name>,” it whispered, nuzzling his shoulder.

<name> smiled, realizing that courage, patience, and kindness can help friends even in tricky situations. From that night on, whenever the moon lit the pond, <name> would look for his unicorn friend, remembering that magical moments often happen when you care for others.
